text:
emma.marketing: Hi team — first full draft of the launch blog is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft-v2. Key asks: tighten hero claim, surface the benchmark snapshot near the top, confirm webinar CTA, and add inbound form tiers + UTM. Quick eyes by EOD please.

rajesh.prodmark: Nice structure. Hero feels a bit fluffy. Can we change to a quant-linked claim: e.g. 'can cut per-token inference costs by up to ~40% for common latency/batch profiles' (if legal OKs). Also let's call the benchmark 'real-traffic traces' not synthetic.

lina.content: Agree with moving the numbers up. Suggest an inline bold callout under the hero that says "Benchmark snapshot: up to ~40% lower per-token cost vs baseline single-instance serving*" and then the footnote link. Also tweak tone: fewer superlatives.

emma.marketing: Drafted a short callout and hero update in the doc. Current phrasing in doc: "Meet Redwood Inference — predictable, production-grade LLM serving that can reduce per-token cost by up to ~40% on common deployment profiles." Natalie, can legal quickpass?

natalie.legal: Quickpass notes: switch to "can reduce" (good), add a footnote linking to methodology and date of runs. Also avoid implying guaranteed savings; keep "up to" and include range if you have one. Don't call out named competitors unless citing public benchmarks. Footnote text suggestion: "*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results vary by model, sequence length, and batch size. See appendix for methodology and dates."

emma.marketing: Thanks. I'll paste that footnote. Lina — can you make the callout visually distinct so readers see it immediately? Alex, design will you do a small card under the hero?

alex.design: Yep can do a small card with a stats bar and a CTA button. Need the exact short copy for the CTA and the 3-line 'what you'll learn' content.

sam.growth: For the registration form: add UTM params: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_launch_q2. Also add a hidden field tag 'launch_interest' and a select for registration type: [Attend live, Watch recording, Interested in case study / pilot]. Send me the HubSpot field map and Ill wire up automation.

emma.marketing: Draft CTA text: "Sign up: Live launch walkthrough + cost playbook". Under CTA: three bullets for 'what you'll learn' — 1) unit-cost levers and benchmark context, 2) deployment checklist for Dedicated/Private, 3) live demo + Q&A. Lina will inline those.

lina.content: Done in doc; shortened bullets to single lines. Added a sentence: "Registering helps us route your request to Sales for a tailored follow-up (select case-study/pilot on the form)."

natalie.legal: Also add a privacy note near the form about data sharing with Sales/HubSpot. Short: "By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; contact data is stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy."

publish-bot: Heads up — publish window opens in 36 hours. Any outstanding approvals must be in before 4pm PT tomorrow to hit the window.

rajesh.prodmark: Small content ask: in the benchmark appendix please include: model family used, sequence lengths, batch sizes, hardware specs, and config toggles for Optimize (caching/quant profiles). That will help customers compare to their workloads.

emma.marketing: Good list — adding to appendix draft. Also adding the UTM snippet to the CTA link. Final CTA link I'll lock to: /events/launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_launch_q2

emma.marketing: Final approvals request: Natalie (legal), Rajesh (product), Lina (content), Alex (design). If I don't hear objections by 4pm PT I will lock and send to design for assets + create the HubSpot form per Sam's mapping.

natalie.legal: Approved with the footnote and privacy note included.

rajesh.prodmark: Approved — nit fixes applied in doc.

lina.content: Approved. Minor copy tidy-up done.

alex.design: Approved on card/layout. Will produce assets by EOD tomorrow.

sam.growth: +1 on UTMs and form fields. I'll start the HubSpot mapping once publish is locked.

emma.marketing: Thanks all 389680 locking content and kicking design handoff now.
